A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BracketIRE/BracketIRE+ research and TMRNet method. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, references, and appendices are readable and can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic and real-world experiments, runtime measurements, and architecture and loss ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains original experimental results and adds full-versus-cropped synthetic-image comparisons in Appendix B, Table A.

M1.justification: The TMRNet architecture, common and frame-specific aggregation modules, supervised pretraining, and self-supervised adaptation losses remain unchanged. The added border-cropping evaluation does not introduce a method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic HDR-video-derived dataset and 200 real-world nighttime smartphone scenes for BracketIRE and BracketIRE+. Border cropping changes evaluation procedures within this retained coverage.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same ten burst-processing and HDR-reconstruction baselines. The new Table A evaluates that same comparator set, and the existing runtime and ablation comparisons are retained.

E3.justification: New Appendix B adds cropped-image evaluation alongside the retained full-image evaluation. For BracketIRE and BracketIRE+, respectively, it excludes 10 and 4 border pixels from inputs and 10 and 16 from ground truth. Existing splits, metrics, and training budgets remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix B and Table A add a sensitivity check on whether invalid boundary pixels affect the comparative results, contrasting full and cropped images. Existing exposure, frame-count, network-depth, and adaptation-loss analyses remain unchanged after renumbering.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the performance comparisons. The added cropped-image table follows the existing point-score reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises scores for six existing baselines; for example, synthetic BracketIRE PSNR changes from 33.92 to 34.67 for MFIR and from 37.01 to 36.62 for Burstormer. New Table A reports cropped-image results, including TMRNet PSNR of 39.06 and 30.65 for BracketIRE and BracketIRE+. These are limited score revisions and an additional evaluation variant: TMRNet's original scores and principal comparative advantage remain unchanged, and the cropped scores are not same-setting gains.

T1.justification: The image-formation and task definitions, network and adaptation equations (1)-(12), and Appendix A noise equations (A)-(B) are unchanged. No theorem, proof, or mathematical derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: unifying restoration and enhancement through exposure bracketing, introducing TMRNet and self-supervised adaptation, and providing datasets with favorable empirical comparisons.

C2.justification: Appendix B newly qualifies the original full-image evaluation as imperfect because black borders contain invalid pixels and affect inference. The existing interpretations and sensor-specific generalization limitation remain unchanged; the latter moves from Appendix G to H.

D1.justification: Appendix B newly discloses that training patches already avoided black borders and specifies the input and ground-truth crop sizes for the added evaluation. This documents an existing training practice rather than establishing a training change. Hardware, hyperparameters, and resource-access information are retained.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 107 cited works are unchanged. Reference-page movement does not introduce or remove literature.

P1.justification: v3 inserts a short Appendix B, updates the supplementary roadmap and appendix cross-references, and makes a small punctuation edit. The main narrative and existing appendix prose are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds Table A with full-image and cropped-image columns, renumbers existing appendix tables, places Figure 6 above Table 6, and moves appendix Figure A onto its own page. Existing figure content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: Appendix B identifies an evaluation weakness, documents border handling, and shows that TMRNet's PSNR and SSIM lead persists after cropping, modestly strengthening the comparison's credibility and transparency. The improvement is limited: the main table retains full-image evaluation, and its revised baseline scores are unexplained.
